item.title: Version 1.3.28
item.description: Fixes and additions since 1.3.27: the gold scroll bar and Delivery Rename tab scroll; Session Setup now works in Manual mode (the job is built from what is on screen), with the Timecode tab and the tempo map made automatically in Manual mode and a 'Tempo map made from' choice on the Tempo Map tab; the Pro Tools Open panel step for the tempo map waits for the file instead of timers (slow external drives); New Track in Track Assign (imported with no track preset); click tracks are left out of the Ref Check stem sum; the app starts in Manual mode, a new project is Manual and an existing project remembers its mode; Auto Mode History panel (scrolls, expands, Undo next to Clear); New Project / Existing Project start screen; numbered tabs; Hide at start up and Close buttons respond to the first click; Delivery Rename tweaks; and a much more useful debug log: where the app stopped, the state of each step and every event of the run, including every update step.
